content: We need to determine SMILES of unknown organic sample using available tools. No experimental data provided in prompt. We need to retrieve SMILES by performing measurements: mass spec, NMR, IR, etc. But we have no initial info. Perhaps the system expects us to use mass_spectrometry_spectra first to get molecular weight, then deduce formula, then propose candidate, then simulate spectra to match. However we have no guidance on peaks. We need to actually call tools to get data. Let's start by measuring mass spectrometry.
